model.name: ONE VIEW BUS — model changes propagate to every view; no view renders silently stale
model.description: Every model change is announced by ONE revision-stamped event UNIT_CHANGED{ior,uuid,hash} on ONE view bus (the EXISTING viewBus, extended to carry the revision), and every view format is a REGISTERED PROJECTION reached ONLY through the bus. Any projection that cannot prove it is current renders VISIBLY STALE (revalidate-or-stale-badge). Adding a view format is REGISTRATION ONLY. The revision = a compute-on-read CONTENT-HASH reusing the federation contentHash (single-source, NOT a counter, NOT a stored bump); currency is fail-closed (unconfirmed == stale). Covers C4.4/C4.5/C4.6 (T37.4.4/.5/.6).
model.tronQuote: > Tron (pre-build, C4 shape): "that's far away from MVC and a view pipeline" -> RE-ISSUED DRY as TWO SINGLETONS (generic mechanism + plugged-in policy); Task = policy #1, sprint board = projection #1.

discoverySource.note: PO SPLIT ruling: R37.4 (objects self-heal, C4.1) must NOT become the C4 umbrella — a req creditable by five unrelated Tests is a folder, not a requirement (over-crediting = shared-credit disease at REQUIREMENT level) + a self-heal-named req containing a controller/bus is the name-vs-content inconsistency Tron flagged. R37.4 STAYS self-heal; this sibling carries the ONE view bus (C4.4/C4.5/C4.6): the revision-stamped bus event + projection registry + revalidate-or-mark-stale + fail-closed currency. T37.4 remains the coordination ROOT task.

model.crossRefNote: MVC family (C4 shape, design c4-mvc-view-pipeline-shape.md): R37.4 self-heal MODEL + R37.11 CONTROLLER + R37.12 VIEW BUS (this). T37.4 = coordination root. The client stale-badge is the piece Tron FEELS (pin-swap-not-appearing).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every unit mutation emits ONE UNIT_CHANGED{ior,uuid,hash} on the EXISTING viewBus (extended to carry the revision); no surface discovers change independently (one event shape, one emit call).

The revision = a compute-on-read CONTENT-HASH reusing the federation contentHash (single-source) — NOT a monotonic counter, NOT a stored bump at the put() chokepoint; currency proved by re-hash + compare (rendered.hash != current.hash -> stale). Cache per (uuid,version) to bound cost.

Every view format REGISTERS as a projection (selects+render); generate-sprint-md = PROJECTION #1; each writes through the C8 owned-output guard. Adding a format is REGISTRATION ONLY — zero bus/pipeline edits (DRY acceptance: throwaway projection works; a pipeline edit for format N+1 -> RED).

The board pipeline regenerates ONLY the affected sprint's owned board(s), DEBOUNCED (coalesce a burst of transitions in one sprint into ONE regen) — never all 144 .md, never unaffected sprints. Cost-bounded so the guard stays enabled.

The live client subscribes to the ws event and on notify / focus / visibilitychange REVALIDATES the affected subtree OR marks it VISIBLY STALE (a badge) — a stale render is never indistinguishable from fresh. This is how never-return-a-silently-drifted-value reaches the RENDER surface (fixes pin-swap-not-appearing).

Unconfirmed currency == STALE, never fresh (same shape as NOT-RUN==RED): a dropped ws / skipped revision / offline -> the node goes stale; the (re)connect welcome piggybacks the current revision for reconcile. The client NEVER assumes fresh because no event arrived.

TEST EXERCISES AC-one-event+AC-scoped-debounced+AC-revalidate-or-stale+AC-fail-closed (distinct-intent): two transitions in one sprint -> exactly ONE scoped regen (RED if it regenerates unaffected sprints / fires per-event); drop the ws / skip a revision -> the open node goes STALE (RED if it renders fresh); register a throwaway projection -> works with zero pipeline edits. Verify Impl.tests[] on disk before flip.

mvc.subscribeOnRender COVERAGE INVARIANT: EVERY view that renders a ref MUST subscribe to it -> it live-updates. GATE RED if a rendered ref is not subscribed (STUB-MUST-FAIL: render a ref without subscribing -> RED). Closes the gap where AC3 live-update marker 9ce0b153 exists but no coverage unit.

ONE view bus, not two: the SECOND observer (trace/ViewBus ref-keyed vs top-level ViewBus classType/uuid) is RETIRED or explicitly declared so there is ONE controller/bus (the two-source disease, R40.18 class). GATE: a 2nd live bus in use -> RED (stub-must-fail).

[DEVICE-ONLY @390 pixel — Tron, un-mockable, NEVER headless-green, TRON-ONLY] A unit change is VISIBLE in the ITEM view AND the DETAIL view with NO manual reload (live), gated @390 by SCREENSHOT+PIXEL (the changed value appears), NEVER a DOM count. AND INV-T: rendering NEVER mutates the model — the unit byte-diff before==after any render == 0. STUB-MUST-FAIL: a stale view / a render that mutates the unit -> RED. Closes Tron's 'not reflecting it in realtime currently'.
